  • One tub, many clients. A facial uses only a few grams, so 1 kg lasts a long time.
  • The same cream clients can buy. Our bulk cream is the same as our retail jars, so clients who like it can take a jar home.

Cream for facial massage in kg

Many parlours ask for a cream for facial massage in kg. Our creams are moisturising creams, not dedicated massage bases, but a rich cream like avocado night cream glides well under the fingers and leaves skin feeling soft and smooth. For a 5–10 minute face and neck massage, warm a small amount between the fingertips and add a little more only if it starts to drag. For a longer massage with more slip, some salons mix in a few drops of a plain face oil.

For clients with oily or acne-prone skin, use the lighter avocado glow cream and keep the massage short. Our night cream for oily skin guide explains why.

Night cream for parlour use

A night cream for parlour use works as the last step of a facial, and as the cream you recommend for home care. If you use a kojic acid or glutathione cream, remind clients to wear sunscreen every morning. Explain realistic timelines: one facial helps skin feel moisturised and look fresh, but a more even look takes 8–12 weeks of regular home use. You can share our guide on how to apply night cream with clients.

Hygiene tips for bulk cream in the salon

  1. Take cream out of the tub with a clean, dry spatula, never fingers.
  2. Put each client's cream in a fresh bowl, and never return leftovers to the tub.
  3. Keep the tub closed between clients and away from the steamer and sunlight.
  4. Patch test new clients on the jawline before a full facial, especially with kojic acid or glutathione cream.
  5. Avoid active creams straight after peels, waxing or threading on the same area.
  6. Write the opening date on the tub and finish older stock first.

Clients who are pregnant, or who have rashes, melasma or painful acne, should see a dermatologist before active facials.

Questions and answers

Do you sell facial cream in kg for salons?

Yes. We supply four creams by weight, from 1 kg, to salons and parlours across India.

Which cream is best for facial massage?

Avocado night cream is the richest and glides best. For oily skin, use the lighter avocado glow cream.

How many facials does 1 kg cover?

It depends on how much you use, but a facial typically takes only a few grams, so one kilo covers a large number of clients.

Can I sell your jars to clients too?

Yes. Mention the number of finished jars you want in your enquiry.

Is the cream safe for every client?

Most people tolerate it well, but patch test every new client and avoid active creams on freshly waxed or peeled skin.

Can I get a sample?

Yes. Ask for one when you message us.
